news.title: JaiBharti Capital Advisory Private Limited cancelled the acquisition of 50% stake in Lord's Mark Industries Limited (BSE:501261).
news.body:
JaiBharti Capital Advisory Private Limited expressed an interest to acquire 50% stake in Lord's Mark Industries Limited (BSE:501261) for INR 48.5 million on February 5, 2026. Under the terms of the acquisition, JaiBharti Capital Advisory Private Limited offered to pay INR 96.96 in cash per share. Lord's Mark Industries Limited has informed JaiBharti Capital Advisory Private Limited that it is not in a position to consider or proceed with any transaction. On February 6, 2026, JaiBharti Capital Advisory Private Limited increased its cash per share from INR 96.96 to INR 97.

news.title: Lord's Mark Industries Limited Appoints Vignesh Waman Poojari as Chief Financial Officer, Effective January 31, 2026
news.body: Lord's Mark Industries Limited has appointed Mr. Vignesh Waman Poojari as its Chief Financial Officer, effective January 31, 2026. The appointment has been approved by the Board and is in line with the company's focus on strengthening financial leadership as it scales operations across its core business verticals. Mr. Poojari is a Chartered Accountant (India) and Certified Public Accountant (USA) with over 24 years of experience across finance, audit, IFRS, and enterprise-scale financial management. He has held senior leadership roles within the Reliance Industries Group, working across renewable energy, digital services, and retail businesses.
